description: Look up the current state of a verification (status, attempts, expiry, and whether it was real). Only a verification made in this connection's mode is found. The "mode" field is "LIVE" for a real billed SMS or "TEST" for a simulation; cost_cents is 0 on a TEST verification, and test_code is the code that completes it (null on a LIVE one).
name: get_verification
title: Get verification
